description_en: Retrieves the details of a certificate, including basic information and public/private key content. You can use this operation to download the certificate content and private key
description_zh: 本接口一般用于获取证书详情，包含基本信息和公私钥内容。可以通过该接口下载证书内容和私钥
name: GetUserCertificateDetail

parameters.description_en:
The certificate ID.
> You can call [ListUserCertificateOrder](~~455804~~) to obtain the certificate ID.
parameters.description_zh:
证书ID。
> 此ID可通过调用[ListUserCertificateOrder](~~455804~~)获取。
parameters.help_en:
The certificate ID.
> You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455804.html to obtain the certificate ID
parameters.help_zh:
证书ID。
> 此ID可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455804.html获取
parameters.name: cert_id

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to filter certificate content from the response. Valid values:
- **true**: The Cert, Key, EncryptCert, EncryptPrivateKey, SignCert, and SignPrivateKey fields are not returned.
- **false**: All fields are returned.

Default value: false.
parameters.description_zh: 值为**true**时，Cert、Key、EncryptCert、EncryptPrivateKey、SignCert、SignPrivateKey信息不返回，**false**时则返回，默认是false。
